'''C-2V9''' was a one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall [[2V9 cargo lifter droid]] produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. It was cylindrical and hovered on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was equipped with a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] jack, high pitch acoustic signaller, broad-band antenna receiver, and a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] lifting arm. It cost 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new and 1,750 credits used. It was present on an [[Imperial communications outpost]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
